billet.titre:
Your ticket,
your name, your seat.
billet.texte: One bus, one seat, one payment: your ticket go reach you by SMS wit QR code and 4-digit code. For di bus park, dem go scan you and you go enter bus.
billet.detail: one bus, one seat, one payment

colis.titre: Dem go follow your parcel reach di end
colis.texte: You go drop your parcel, we go snap am, then di person wey go receive am go get code to collect. You go follow every step till dem deliver am.

proches.titre: Your people go know when you reach
proches.texte: Your person fit follow your bus live for di map, and e go get SMS by itself when you reach.
